value.rationale: The conversion–mortality equality is a natural unresolved boundary of the 2026 protected-predator model. The nontrivial spatial prey resolvent sets an exact algebraic extinction coefficient independent of positive predator diffusivity. The nonzero shrinking-habitat area-time mass, obtained only after long-time relaxation, is a structurally motivated and surprising contrast to plain area scaling and to the source’s supercritical positive equilibrium-mass limit.
